annotation: The participant maintained eye contact with a focused gaze, nodded slightly, blinked, and kept their hands behind their back.
The participant tilted their head to the right, interlocked their fingers with arms outstretched down, and maintained eye contact with their partner.

The participant, with their right hand behind their back and their legs crossed, gave a broad smile, reached up with their left hand and touched their left eyelashes, and lifted an eyebrow, and then put their left hand on their hip.
The participant smiled with upturned lips, squinted, tilted their head to the left, and held their hands clasped in front of them.
The participant maintained eye contact with their partner and rolled their shoulders back and forth, hands clasped behind their back.
The participant bent over slightly, laughed, and held their hands behind their back.
The participant touched their right ear with their left hand, furrowed their brow, and widened their eyes.
